title: No exemption without a cost
statement: An exemption from a check is granted by someone other than whoever claims it, never self-declared, and must put a measured outcome in place of each one it waives.
detail: A self-audit of the reading project's quality gate found a latent escape: any course could declare itself engagement-primary in its README and mark every outcome row not applicable; its proposed fix makes the exemption granted rather than self-declared, with a measured engagement outcome replacing each row it nullifies, so it costs an outcome instead of waiving one (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0069-self-audit-insights.qmd`). A draft certification standard keeps a known-debt list that can only shrink and is never padded to pass a build (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0217-team-direction-2026-09-09.qmd`).
against: Neither is recorded as in force: one is an audit's recommendation and the other sits in a draft standard that binds nobody (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0217-team-direction-2026-09-09.qmd`).

each nullified MAP row must be **replaced by a measured engagement OUTCOME** (retention / completion-quality) so "engagement-primary" costs an outcome rather than waiving one.
so the hatch *costs* an outcome rather than *waiving* one;
It is an exact-string list of content that predates a rule. An unlisted violation hard-fails; an entry that matches nothing also fails, so fixing something forces its entry deleted.
- **`known-debt.mjs` may only SHRINK.** Never add to it to make a build pass.
reverted in favour of an honest debt entry.
Do not add a suppression list — the whole file is four lines of prose and re-reading it is cheaper than maintaining exact-string exemptions that rot the moment a lesson is edited.

Content that predates a rule is not an exception — it is listed item by item; the list WARNS on every run instead of failing (so debt stays visible); an unlisted violation still FAILS; an entry nothing currently matches FAILS (an exemption that outlived its cause is a silencer); and the list may only shrink.
Pre-existing findings ride `voice-laws-debt.json` with shrink-only semantics: listed warns, unlisted fails, a stale entry fails.
